Protein Food

Hanger Steak

About This Entry

Hanger steak is a single muscle attached to the diaphragm with a loose, juicy texture and deep beef flavor. Once a butcher's secret, it pairs like strip steak — structured reds with enough fruit to match its intensity.

Beginner Guide

Hanger has a thick center seam — many chefs remove it and cook as two pieces. Cook no more than medium-rare for best texture.

FAQ

What is Hanger Steak?
Hanger has a thick center seam — many chefs remove it and cook as two pieces.
How should Hanger Steak be cooked for best results?
Cook to medium-rare or medium depending on thickness; rest 5–10 minutes and slice against the grain when the muscle grain is visible.
